Open with the diagnostic, not the pitch: "I looked your business up on Google and it's got <the thing above>. Here's exactly what to change; it's free, whether or not we talk again."
The close: "If you'd rather not think about it again: text Patch and it's done. Your site, your hours, your prices, changed in a minute by a number you text. It's $99 a month and I'm on the hook for all of it."
Then the tool, if they quote jobs: "Your site can take quote requests and bookings, and they land on a private page only you open: who asked, what for, marked new, replied or done. There's a working one on the pool-care demo at patchlamp.com/templates."

Log every conversation by text: "log <name> talked|interested|… <note>" (`leads log`). Owner replies to reviews aren't in the Places API — glance at the listing for unanswered ones.
